title: Change rotor.rotate_after: any occurrence of a multi-character mark
prompt:
The package rotor in the current directory has `rotate_after(text, letter)` (rotor/core.py), which moves the part of `text` up to and including the first `letter` to the end, and `rotate_all(items, letter)` (rotor/batch.py). Change them to

    rotate_after(text, mark, occurrence=1)
    rotate_all(items, mark, occurrence=1)

with this behaviour:
- `mark` is any non-empty string. Its occurrences are found left to right without overlapping (after a match the search resumes at the end of that match).
- occurrence=k > 0 picks the k-th of those occurrences from the left; k < 0 picks the |k|-th from the right (-1 is the last). If there are fewer than |k| occurrences, `text` is returned unchanged.
- With the chosen occurrence starting at index i, the result is text[i+len(mark):] + text[:i+len(mark)].
- ValueError when `mark` is empty or `occurrence` is 0.
- rotate_all applies rotate_after with the same mark and occurrence to every item and returns a new list.

tests/test_rotor.py has a few examples (run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`); a hidden suite checks the full behaviour. Do not modify tests/test_rotor.py.
